findings.title: Agitating utterance
findings.claim: The utterance can be felt as a measured jolt that unsettles settled non-recognition and directs the exchange back toward brotherhood.
findings.mechanism: The supplied trace pairs the focus speech and ignorance carriers with movement and agitation, then follows the disturbance into the rapid recognition exchange before the brother relation gives it a restorative destination.
findings.reader_payoff: The question is newly perceptible as an event that changes the room's stability, not only as a static label of past conduct.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory, form-distant split-root activation. It must not translate قَالَ as agitation or displace the ordinary speech meaning; it only describes the effect attributed to the utterance in the supplied exchange.

epistemic.reason: The exact 12:89 and 12:90 surfaces are supplied, but the HFT record explicitly marks the movement reading as a non-dominant split-root outlier.
